descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S02 Step 3: the production Convex backup setting matches the documented configuration

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 Backups are encrypted, taken daily only, kept 7 days for disaster recovery and documented; the Convex backup setting matches the documented configuration. (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 3; UAT OAT-04 Expected 3; TFA-94699 AC 8; TFA-94703 AC 1 (B4)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-94703 development backlog

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The production deployment (Venkata Technologies' Convex Pro account) and the written backup configuration (where it lives is Q12)

When A person with dashboard access opens the deployment's backup settings and compares them with the document

Then Backups are on, daily only, kept 7 days and encrypted, and every value matches the document

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-04 step 3 / Expected 3, TFA-94699 AC 8, TFA-94703 B4: any value other than daily / 7 days / encrypted, a mismatch with the document, or no document = Fail. Whether the document must also say who can restore and how is Q12 ('needs a decision', not a Fail). Evidence: dated screenshot of the setting and the document link, attached to the UAT result

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: CONFIG · Config check; secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
